motifs.name: central_mountain_massif
motifs.description: Dominant tan-and-gray mountain peak with steep shoulders, nested ravines, pale wash slopes, and dense dark cun-texture strokes descending into the central valley; isolate the peak and mountain body without the village buildings below.

pale ochre wash over the broad central face
